projects.readmeExcerpt: OpenCodeReview English 简体中文 日本語 한국어 Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface level diff feedback. projects.name: ag-ui
projects.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
projects.readmeExcerpt: The open protocol that connects any agent to any app. Docs · Examples · Spec · Discord AG UI is an open, lightweight, event based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user facing applications. Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack. [!IMPORTANT] AG UI 1.0 is here.
